_meta.note: Buckets mirror provider documentation. We stay strictly UNDER the documented limit. Never evade a quota by creating extra accounts.
_meta.recheck_note: 2026-08-12: re-verified against official pages after a Jupiter Portal key and a Helius key were obtained. Jupiter publishes a FREE KEYED tier at 1 RPS / 60 RPM that this file did not previously name; withKeyRequestsPerSecond was 1.0, i.e. exactly at the documented ceiling and in breach of the 'strictly UNDER' rule above. It had never been exercised because no key existed. Lowered to 0.8, preserving the same 0.8x headroom ratio the keyless bucket uses (0.4 of 0.5).

buckets.name: jupiter_main
buckets.documented: 0.5 RPS / 30 RPM keyless; 1 RPS / 60 RPM on the free Portal-keyed tier. Per organisation, 60s sliding window, shared across Swap, Price and Token APIs. /swap/v2/execute has its own bucket.

buckets.name: jupiter_execute
buckets.documented: Separate bucket. Keyless 20 RPS. Costs 0 credits.

buckets.name: dexscreener_300
buckets.documented: 300 req/min for pairs, search and token-pairs endpoints.

buckets.name: dexscreener_60
buckets.documented: 60 req/min for token-profiles and token-boosts endpoints.

buckets.name: solana_public_rpc
buckets.documented: Solana Labs public RPC: 100 req/10s per IP, 40 req/10s per method, 40 concurrent connections.

buckets.name: helius_rpc
buckets.documented: Free plan 10 req/s RPC, 1M credits/month at 1 credit per standard RPC call. sendTransaction capped at 1/s on free. Auth is the ?api-key= query parameter, so the key is part of the URL.

buckets.name: helius_das
buckets.documented: DAS and Enhanced APIs 2 req/s on free plan. Separate rate bucket from RPC but the SAME monthly credit pool, at 10 credits per DAS call against 1 for standard RPC — so DAS spends the 1M allowance ten times faster and rate headroom is not credit headroom.

buckets.name: goplus
buckets.documented: Free rate limit NOT documented. Conservative self-imposed cap until verified.
